description: This file defines the TouchPad class for handling touch input in a cross-platform Unity game, including virtual axes creation, touch handling, and input updates.

classes.name: TouchPad
classes.description: Handles touch input for a virtual joystick, supporting different control styles and axes options.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Initializes virtual axes when the component is enabled.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Sets up the image component and center position in non-editor environments.

methods.name: CreateVirtualAxes
methods.description: Creates and registers virtual axes based on configuration.

methods.name: UpdateVirtualAxes
methods.description: Updates the virtual axes with normalized input values.

methods.name: OnPointerDown
methods.description: Handles pointer down event, initiating dragging and setting the center position.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates input based on touch or mouse movement while dragging.

methods.name: OnPointerUp
methods.description: Handles pointer up event, stopping dragging and resetting axes.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Unregisters virtual axes when the component is disabled.
